A remake for already a great game

When Risk of rain 1 remake was first announced, it felt a bit unnecessary to me as I had played original experience back in 2020 and it worked well still seven years later of original release. However since I have enjoyed a lot from all previous games made by Hopoo games, I decided to give the remake a try and I'm glad I did.

While graphics improvement are easy too see, when you play the game you notice much more improvements that are made to the experience.
+ Mouse and keyboard experience is as good as playing with controller.
+ Couple of new playable characters
+ Sub-abilities to different classes
+ Stage-variants
+ Map-teleportation activation only requires to kill boss and survive 90 seconds and not kill all enemies
+ New items to collect during a run

And of course, Chris Christodoulou's music is still great.

Only thing I could say as a negative when compared to original release is a lack of mod-support, so hopefully that will be brought to remake one day.

Verdict:
If you liked the original experience and don't mind the lack of mod-support, Risk of rain Returns is a good (and challenging) roguelike experience, filled with great music, gameplay and great optimization at it's 15 bucks asking price.

I loved RoR1, then was blown away by RoR2 but I think the Devs made a very good choice on remastering the first version. It has the same feel as the original but with new content and more sophisticated artwork.

I love the artwork and music, which helps, but I'm just pushed by motivation every time to try and do better. The game includes a satisfying progress system, unlocking DATA for items, monsters and worlds as you go, but most importantly achieve challenges to unlock skills and characters.

As in all RoR games, you start from scratch, with only your character's perks/skills and a couple of coins. Play the game to gain coins, unlock chests, buy buffs, kill monsters (some of which drop buffs) and as time passed the difficulty increases with a speed depending on the overall difficulty selection. Don't waste time wandering around.

Risk of Rain Returns is everything the original game was and much more.

Survivors skills are akin to RoR2 where you have additional unlockables skills which allows for more varied and customisable playstyles on all survivors, unlike the original RoR1 where each survivor only had their initial skills.

There's new items

There's new enemies

There's new survivors

But most importantly, there's new and remastered bangers from Chris Christodoulou.

RoR1 Fans: Seriously, why are you still reading reviews, get this game already, it's faithful to the original while still adding a variety of new stuff.

RoR2 Fans: If you've never played the original RoR and are worried whether this would still feel like the same game in 2D, I'd suggest you bite the bullet and give it a shot. I had the exact same worry when RoR2 early access started, I thought the 3D was a bit weird and thought risk of rain wouldn't feel the same if it wasn't 2D, boy was I wrong.

Overall, whether you've played RoR1, RoR2 or neither, this is a solid roguelike game and it's relatively cheap for how much fun you can get out of it. Highly recommend.
